description: Read-only check of any task description you found anywhere, before you start it: which of the eleven things a task must say it seems to say, goal, acceptance, target, boundaries, output, inputs, evaluator, reward, deadline, what to do when unclear, spend cap, and the three questions to ask its author first. Keyword signals, no model: it says how sure it is. Stores nothing. Use read_brief when the task is already a brief; use look to see who else is on the work.

text.description: the task as its author wrote it, up to 8000 characters

name: lint_task
title: Lint a task text
